content: Predicting the distribution of 100 species across Europe, using the European network of nature protected sites Natura 2000 dataset as ground truth. For each of these species, a binary classification problem is considered. The set of locations INLINEFORM0 is defined as the 26,425 distinct sites occurring in the dataset.
